chars.name: Jethro
chars.info: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, gave him wise advice about sharing the work of judging the people.
clues: I was the father-in-law of Moses.
I was a priest of Midian.
I came out to meet Moses in the wilderness with joy.
I advised Moses to appoint able men to share the judging. Who am I?

chars.name: Bezalel
chars.info: Bezalel was the craftsman filled with the Spirit of God to build the tabernacle.
clues: I was called by name by the LORD.
I was filled with the Spirit of God.
I was skilled in gold, silver and brass.
I was the chief craftsman of the tabernacle. Who am I?

chars.name: Jochebed
chars.info: Jochebed was the mother of Moses, who hid him in the bulrushes and then gave him back to Pharaoh's daughter.
clues: I was a Levite woman and the mother of Moses.
I hid my baby for three months.
I put him in an ark of bulrushes by the river.
Pharaoh's daughter paid me to nurse my own son. Who am I?

chars.name: Jeremiah
chars.info: Jeremiah was called as a young man to warn Judah, and suffered for his faithful words.
clues: I was called to be a prophet while still a child.
I wept over the sins of my people.
I was put in a pit and rescued by a faithful servant.
I wrote a letter to the exiles in Babylon. Who am I?

chars.name: Baruch
chars.info: Baruch was the scribe who wrote down Jeremiah's words and read them to the people.
clues: I was the scribe of the prophet Jeremiah.
I wrote down all the words of the LORD from Jeremiah's mouth.
I read the scroll in the house of the LORD.
My name is found in the book of Jeremiah. Who am I?

chars.name: Ebedmelech
chars.info: Ebedmelech was an Ethiopian official who rescued Jeremiah from the cistern.
clues: I was a eunuch in the king's house.
I was an Ethiopian.
I drew Jeremiah out of the dungeon with ropes.
I took old rags to put under his arms. Who am I?

chars.name: Ezekiel
chars.info: Ezekiel was a priest among the exiles by the river Chebar, who was made a watchman for Israel.
clues: I was a priest taken into exile by the river Chebar.
I saw the glory of the LORD in great visions.
I was made a watchman for the house of Israel.
I saw dry bones come to life. Who am I?

chars.name: Gog
chars.info: Gog was the prince of Meshech and Tubal, who came against Israel in Ezekiel's prophecy.
clues: I was the prince of Meshech and Tubal.
I came from the land of Magog.
I came up against Israel like a storm.
God said I would be buried in the valley of Hamongog. Who am I?

chars.name: Aholibah
chars.info: Aholibah is the name Ezekiel gives to Jerusalem, in an allegory of two sisters.
clues: I was one of two sisters in an allegory of unfaithfulness.
My sister was Aholah, the name for Samaria.
I went after lovers and forgot the LORD.
I was judged for my whoredoms. Who am I?

chars.name: Hosea
chars.info: Hosea was a prophet whose marriage to an unfaithful wife pictured God's love for Israel.
clues: The LORD told me to take a wife of whoredoms.
I named my children to speak God's judgment on Israel.
I was told to love a woman again who had left me.
I bought her back for fifteen pieces of silver. Who am I?

chars.name: Gomer
chars.info: Gomer was the wife of Hosea, who left him and was brought back in love.
clues: I was the wife of a prophet.
I bore children to the prophet Hosea.
I went after other lovers.
I was bought back by my husband with silver and barley. Who am I?

story.title: The twelve spies
cards: Moses sends twelve men to explore the land of Canaan
The spies bring back fruit, and ten of them say the people are too strong
Caleb and Joshua say the land can be taken with God's help
The people weep and rebel, and God judges that generation to wander
story.heart: When fear speaks louder than God's promise, whose voice do you listen to?
story.mission: Speak one faithful word this week, even if others see things differently.

story.title: Jericho falls
cards: Rahab hides two spies on her roof
She makes a promise with the spies and ties a scarlet cord in her window
Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground and marches around Jericho
The walls fall down, and Rahab and her family are saved
story.heart: What does Rahab's courage teach you about trusting God's promises?
story.mission: Show courage this week by keeping a promise, even when it is costly.

story.title: Gideon and the three hundred
cards: Gideon threshes wheat in a winepress to hide from Midian
God calls him a mighty man of valour and asks him to save Israel
Gideon reduces his army to three hundred men
They break the pitchers, blow the trumpets, and the enemy flees
story.heart: Where might God be asking you to trust him with less, so that he gets the glory?
story.mission: Do one task this week that depends on God's strength rather than your own resources.

story.title: Ruth and Boaz
cards: Ruth stays with Naomi and goes to Bethlehem with her
Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz
Boaz redeems the family land and marries Ruth
Their son Obed becomes the grandfather of King David
story.heart: How has God shown his faithfulness to you through the kindness of others?
story.mission: Show kindness to someone who is a stranger or in need this week.

story.title: David and Goliath
cards: The Philistines gather for battle, and Goliath challenges Israel
David, a young shepherd, comes with a sling and five smooth stones
David says the battle is the LORD's
A stone from the sling strikes Goliath, and David wins
story.heart: What giant in your life needs you to trust God's strength rather than your own?
story.mission: Take on one challenge this week that you have been avoiding, trusting God to help you.

story.title: David and Bathsheba
cards: David stays in Jerusalem while his army goes to war
He sees Bathsheba bathing and sends for her
He arranges for Uriah to die in battle
Nathan confronts David, who confesses: I have sinned against the LORD
story.heart: What does David's confession teach you about how to respond when you are found out?
story.mission: Confess one hidden fault to God this week, and seek the help of a trusted friend.

story.title: Elijah on Mount Carmel
cards: Elijah challenges the prophets of Baal to a contest on Mount Carmel
The prophets of Baal cry out all day, but no answer comes
Elijah repairs the altar of the LORD and pours water over the sacrifice
Fire falls from heaven, and the people say: The LORD, he is God
story.heart: Whom are you serving, and how would you know if your devotion is real?
story.mission: Remove one idol from your life this week, and set time aside to worship the LORD alone.

story.title: Naaman is healed
cards: Naaman, a commander of Syria, is a leper
A young Israelite girl tells him of the prophet Elisha
Elisha tells him to wash seven times in the Jordan
Naaman obeys, is healed, and praises the God of Israel
story.heart: What pride might stop you from doing a simple thing God asks of you?
story.mission: Do the simple thing God has been asking you to do this week, and be humble about it.

story.title: David brings the ark home
cards: David gathers all Israel to bring the ark of God to Jerusalem
The Levites carry the ark on their shoulders, as the law commanded
David dances before the LORD with all his might
David appoints Levites to thank, praise and sing before the ark
story.heart: How do you express joy in worship, even when it is not what others expect?
story.mission: Give thanks and sing praise to God this week, aloud or in your heart, every day.

story.title: Solomon builds the temple
cards: Solomon prepares to build a house for the name of the LORD
He asks Huram of Tyre for cedar and skilled craftsmen
The temple is finished and the ark is brought into the Most Holy Place
The glory of the LORD fills the house, and the people worship
story.heart: What would it mean for your life to be a house in which God's presence dwells?
story.mission: Prepare a place in your home or church for prayer and worship this week, and use it daily.

story.title: The return and the rebuilding
cards: Cyrus, king of Persia, lets the exiles go home to Jerusalem
The people return and build the altar, then the foundation of the temple
Opponents try to stop the work, and it stops for years
Haggai and Zechariah encourage the people, and the temple is finished
story.heart: When has discouragement made you stop building what God has asked you to build?
story.mission: Return to one piece of unfinished work this week, and ask God for encouragement to finish it.

story.title: Rebuilding the walls
cards: Nehemiah hears that Jerusalem's walls are broken and prays
The king sends him to Jerusalem to rebuild the walls
Opponents mock and threaten, but the people keep working with a sword in one hand
The wall is finished in fifty-two days, and the enemies see that God has done it
story.heart: What wall in your life or community needs rebuilding, and who could help you?
story.mission: Join or start one practical act of service this week, and pray for the people you serve.

story.title: Esther speaks for her people
cards: Haman plots to destroy the Jews, and Mordecai asks Esther to act
Esther fasts, then goes in to the king without being called
She invites the king and Haman to a banquet, then asks for her people's lives
The king gives the Jews the right to defend themselves, and Haman is hanged
story.heart: Where has God placed you for a time such as this, and what courage does it require?
story.mission: Speak up this week for someone who is being treated unjustly, in a way that is wise and kind.

story.title: Job's trial and restoration
cards: Job is blameless and upright, and he loses his children and wealth
His friends come to comfort him, and they sit silent with him for seven days
Job questions God, and then bows in worship: I have heard of thee
God restores Job, giving him twice as much as he had before
story.heart: What does Job teach you about trusting God when the reason for your suffering is unclear?
story.mission: Pray honestly this week, bringing your questions to God, and listen for his answer in Scripture.

story.title: Jesus walks on the water
cards: The disciples are in a boat, tossed by the waves, and afraid
Jesus comes to them walking on the sea and says: Be of good cheer
Peter asks to come to Jesus, and steps out of the boat onto the water
Peter sinks, cries out, and Jesus lifts him up; the storm ceases
story.heart: When have you been afraid, and how did Jesus meet you in that fear?
story.mission: Take one step of faith this week, and call on Jesus when you begin to sink.

story.title: Jairus's daughter and the woman
cards: Jairus begs Jesus to come and heal his dying daughter
On the way, a woman who has bled for twelve years touches his clothes and is healed
Jesus asks who touched him, and the woman comes trembling and tells the truth
Jesus raises Jairus's daughter, saying: Be not afraid, only believe
story.heart: Where do you need to come to Jesus with courage, even if you feel small or unseen?
story.mission: Bring a need to Jesus in prayer this week, and be honest with him about it.

story.title: The man born blind
cards: Jesus sees a man who has been blind from birth
Jesus makes clay from spittle, anoints his eyes, and sends him to wash in Siloam
The man comes back seeing, and his neighbours and the Pharisees question him
He answers: One thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see
story.heart: How has Jesus given you sight in an area where you were once blind?
story.mission: Tell someone this week what Jesus has done in your life, in one honest sentence.

story.title: Paul and Silas in Philippi
cards: Paul casts an evil spirit out of a slave girl, and her owners drag them before the magistrates
Paul and Silas are beaten and put in the inner prison with their feet in stocks
At midnight they pray and sing hymns, and an earthquake opens the doors
The jailer asks what he must do to be saved, and his whole household believes
story.heart: How might God use your suffering to bring someone else to faith?
story.mission: Pray and sing praise this week in a difficult situation, and share your faith with one person.
